hotbee-rednote-collect v1.0.2

- Updated SKILL.md, agents/openai.yaml, and references/api.md with clarifications and edits.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Documentation now more clearly specifies handling of public note URLs and verified endpoints.
Add official HotBee website links and GitHub source provenance

Initial release of HotBee Rednote Collect skill.

- Enables parsing and collecting Xiaohongshu (Rednote) note content using the HotBee xhs_note_content endpoint.
- Only processes explicitly supplied public note URLs; does not bypass platform security or restrictions.
- Requires confirmation before any action that consumes HotBee quota.
- Reads the HOTBEE_API_KEY from the local environment and does not expose sensitive information.
- Focuses exclusively on processing note content, not user profiles or search functions.
